rationale: The workflow already uses `setup-node` with `cache: npm` which implements dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE). The job is a deployment workflow (GitHub Pages), which is a contraindication for P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (cancel superseded runs). No matrix exists for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST. No representative duration history is available to safely set a custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT requires history; the single historical run completed in ~53s). The workflow triggers only on version tags and manual dispatch, so path filtering (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER) and schedule optimizations (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE) are inapplicable. No Bazel, test selection, or build selection patterns apply. Therefore, no evidence-supported optimization can be safely applied without violating contraindications or lacking preconditions.
